name: Khvarenah
source:
Khvarenah is the first rank of Seven Archdemons and the creator of Quinn. His domain is Star Cluster of Extinction Saurva.

A Star Spirit, he is one of the seven absolute Evils ruling on the Dragvant side. 20 years ago, he invaded the domain of Wahman Yast, wounded Vohu Manah, and defeated [url=https://vndb.org/c111567]Varhram[/url] and devoured all but 30 of the Yazata.

As he destroyed and devoured planets, he heard the final thoughts of the Ashavan as they prayed for a miracle to destroy him. To Khvarenah, these were intriguing. "What is a miracle?" "How many prayers can create such a thing?" "How does hope factor in?" To a living factory, numbers and logic are very important. As he was on the Dragvant, he saw those on the Ashavan as insane, but he couldn't disregard those final words. As such, he created an automaton, [url=https://vndb.org/c111534]Quinn[/url], to meet and understand those on the side of Good and to collect their thoughts, prayers and miracles, deriving a logical formula out of them
